# JQB Copilot Agents

This folder contains custom agents for VS Code GitHub Copilot.

## Available Agents

- JQB Project Accelerator
- JQB Architecture Planner
- JQB UI Builder
- JQB IO Integrator
- JQB Docs and Release Steward
- JQB Firmware App Bridge
- JQB Audio DSP UI
- JQB CAM Pipeline Engineer

## Recommended Usage

1. Start with JQB Project Accelerator for end-to-end task orchestration.
2. Use specialized agents for focused tasks.
3. Combine with skills from ../skills for repeatable workflows.
